stage_a_vision.name: Vision AI — Describe Only

output.visible_object: string — main visible object, describe objectively
output.visible_brand: string|null — brand name/logo visible, null if none

rules: Only describe what is visible. Do NOT classify.
Do NOT output system_type, category, or subcategory.
If unsure about brand, set visible_brand=null.

stage_b_industrial.name: Industrial AI — Classify from Vision + Context
stage_b_industrial.input: Stage A result + existing metadata + taxonomy rules

output.system_type: string|null — one of 8 fixed values or null
output.application: array[string] — industrial applications, empty if unknown

rules: Brand is horizontal attribute, not classification level.
Seal → asset_type=component, system_type may be null.
Filter → determine specific type before assigning system.
Unknown/ambiguous is acceptable. Do not force classify.
